Inspired by international graduate schools, the Life Sciences graduate program brings together the strengths of PSL University in the life sciences. By networking the actors of the various PSL institutions (ENS-PSL, EPHE-PSL, Collège de France, ESPCI Paris-PSL, Institut Curie), and the Q-LIFE Convergence Institute [add link], the Life Sciences graduate program develops a variety of initiatives: training through research and personalized study paths, interdisciplinarity, and the internationalization of curricula and career opportunities. Backed by the best laboratories and teams at PSL University, the graduate programs strengthen the links between master's and doctoral programs and create new opportunities for student and scientific communities.

A five-year track from Master’s to PhD
PSL PhD tracks | Join outstanding students from around the globe & launch your world-class research career with PSL Graduate program
PSL University's highly selective PhD Tracks prepare students for research careers in France or abroad, in academia or industry.
These five-year programs are designed for high-potential students who want to tackle the scientific challenges of tomorrow and begin preparing their research projects while still in their master's program. Immersed in the ecosystem of excellence of PSL's Life Sciences graduate program (top-level laboratories and academic teams, international partners), successful applicants benefit from a personalized program focused on their thesis topic from the first year of their master's degree.
Why join PSL's PhD track?
An excellent curriculum (Master's + PhD) accessible in M1
Funding for the entire duration of your studies (5 years) & a welcome package in year 1
All courses taught in English
Close supervision & support for professional integration
Immersion in a multicultural & cutting-edge scientific environment in the heart of Paris
Find out more (admissions, scholarships, etc.)

Personalized course offerings
Complementary university-wide courses
Graduate program students at both the Master’s and PhD level have access to university-wide trainings in core competencies, both introductory and advanced, designed to supplement their academic study.
Those complementary university-wide courses, available in all of PSL’s component schools, are eligible for ECTS credit.

Career opportunities
Trained in and through research, PSL alumni find numerous employment opportunities in the public, private and entrepreneurial sectors as well as in the academic world.
Pursue a PhD
Doctoral research is conducted in a PSL laboratory. Training is conducted in a doctoral school.
